definitions.explanation: Of hair, partly gray: dark hair with white or gray strands mixed in.

examples.japanese: {白髪交|しらがま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{白髪交|しらがま}じりになった。
examples.english: My father's hair has gone quite gray now too.

examples.japanese: {白髪交|しらがま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{穏|おだ}やか→穏やか：02353_odayaka⟧な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A gentleman with graying hair kindly told me the way in a calm voice.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually before a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {白髪交|しらがま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧, {白髪交|しらがま}じり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧. 〜{交|ま}じり means "mixed with ~" and appears in other compounds such as {雨交|あめま}じり (with rain mixed in) and {冗談交|じょうだんま}じり (half joking).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ごま{塩頭|しおあたま}: "salt-and-pepper hair"; a more colorful, informal description of the same thing
- ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧: gray or white hair itself
